mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.edits: char edit: row min(caret, n - 1), s = +1 (60%) / -1 (40%), d0' = clamp(d0 + s, 1, 255), d1' = clamp(d1 + s, d0', 255) (R-BA24); Enter: row r = caret, column c uniform in [0, d0 - 1], setMeasure(r, 0, c + 1), setMeasure(r, 1, d1a), insertAt(r + 1, d0 - c, d1b), d1a / d1b re-drawn by the d1 rule, caret r + 1 (R-BA23); backspace: r = max(1, caret) joins into r - 1, min(255, a + b - 1) per dim, removeAt(r), caret r - 1 (R-BA24); mid edit: rows [s, s + k), k uniform in [10, 50], s = min(caret, n - k), fresh d0 / d1 per row, d0 then d1 (R-BA25)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.seeks: indexAtSum(0, prefix(r) + uniform [0, d0(r))), r = min(caret, n - 1); sumBefore(0, i), i = clamp(caret + uniform [-50, 50], 0, n) (R-BA17, R-BA27)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
mix.phases: seek, reweight, edit, bulk, blend (blend last)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)

mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)

mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)

mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)

mix.lines: d0 = UTF-16 units incl. the newline: 1 for 10%, uniform [2, 81] for 85%, uniform [82, 255] for 5%; d1 = UTF-8 bytes: d0 for 90%, else d0 + uniform [1, d0], capped at 255 (R-BA17); fill row i = [d0, d1]
mix.caret: starts uniform in [0, n); before every event: 1% jump to a uniform row in [0, length), else clamp(caret + uniform [-3, 3], 0, length - 1) (R-BA27)
mix.bulk: L = max(2, floor(U x min(1, n / 100000))), U uniform in [2000, 10000]; cut rows [i, i + L), i uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(i + L, tail), SPLIT(i, clip), APPEND(tail); its paste at j uniform in [0, n - L] = SPLIT(j, tail), APPEND(clip), APPEND(tail) (R-BA21, R-BA26)
mix.order: R-BA19: each block is a seeded Fisher-Yates shuffle of its exact class counts; a cut and its paste fill two adjacent slots (one unit); Enter / backspace alternate in stream order, Enter first
mix.event: R-BA20: an event is 1+ records of one class (char 2 setMeasure, Enter 2 setMeasure + insertAt, backspace 2 setMeasure + removeAt, mid 2k setMeasure, cut 3, paste 3, seek 1); events counts events, ops records
mix.views: 3 (main, clip, tail); capacity n + 1 is the arena total (R-BA21)
